backend: Historical frozen A30 scalar-TM 24x24 8-source/32-receiver, physically identical existing implementation; no Research T code modifications
selection: Prespecified existing cached base compatibility, original source predictions, ID order; no truth reads
sigma: Only sigma key from frozen same-case A30 A29 pool
repair_hypothesis: Within-neighborhood lower-full-residual representative replacement can avoid losing quality while preserving immutable success ledger and unchanged structural reward. It need not improve discovery.
paired_rng: Same method/case RNG stream across rounds, no round term; archive changes may affect later parent fields/proposals
method_order: Predetermined random permutation for each round/case
corrector: Unmodified src.research_a.e2._gn_proposal, inherited 32-real Haar chart from _bases, same 2 steps for all methods, trust=.35 then x.3 on rejected full-state step
corrector_endpoint: Smallest full residual among raw and two corrected states; independent fresh full solve of its exact field before archive offer
receiver_transfer_cache: Legitimate same-state reuse within each trajectory retained; clear at trajectory end to release LU/state references. Never solve again to manufacture equal RHS spending.
primary_cost_comparison: Matched attempted material states. Actual RHS, setup, correction, independent validation and wall are separately recorded; RHS need not be exactly equal.

operators.global: Same inherited 32-real Haar basis; independent Gaussian coefficients normalized to peak .8 around the legal base, physical box projection. This is correlated field restart, not uniform material prior.
operators.local_remove: Gaussian continuous center/scale/amplitude edit toward saved known background; location from candidate contrast>0.18 or full grid, no truth
operators.local_add: Gaussian continuous center/scale/amplitude edit toward saved background+fixed nominal 1.2+0.12i contrast; full grid site, no truth
operators.distributed: Continuous Haar coefficient perturbation around selected archive parent, same legal material box

method_choices.multistart: Three independent base-centered correlated global restarts
method_choices.static_scale: First global; two continuous signed local edits spanning scales1.5/3/6 pixels and amplitudes.45/.7/.95 across ID-ordered cases, no hole-count classes
method_choices.QD: First forced global; fixed uniform emitter mixture afterward; archive parent selected by low use then material/structure novelty
method_choices.bandit: First forced global; Beta(.5,.5) sampling among identical four operators afterward; same archive parent rule; only post-correction structural new-world indicator updates reward

defensive_global: Step0 forced before any screening: at least1/3 of proposals; no surrogate screening at all
reward: Structural separation against every prefix full-valid success-ledger endpoint, including duplicates and base; NOT material-OR-structure OfferResult.new_world_reward
archive: g_archive metric/version and pairwise packing; first/quality replacement only difference across rounds; old worlds remain immutable and cannot earn repeated discovery
scope_limits: 32-real correction chart is not full material domain

outputs.costs: Only independent G COST_LEDGER.jsonl / FAILURE_LEDGER.jsonl; no historical ledger writes
